name: Wuxi Xinjie Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Xinjie Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and application of automation products in China and internationally. It offers industrial control products, including programmable controller, IO system, human-machine interface, and integrated controller; motion control products, such as servo driver and motor, frequency inverter, and stepping system; industrial cloud platform and IoT gateway and touch screen; visual application platform and system accessories; and industrial robots comprising robot system, software, and accessories, as well as maintenance and after-sales services.
